identification: The shipped Versus editor names ASBasePawn::Crouch in the guard at VA 0x114a2e40, used by the override at VA 0x11206990. The matching retail SBasePawn vtable at VA 0x10bfa168 places the override at slot 81. The method handles the simulated-proxy flag path, switches to the reflected crouched capsule size, lowers the pawn with a swept move and calls the StartCrouch event with the height adjustment. The outer frame unwinds with RET 4 at the end of the measured function.
